description: This file is a shell script used to test the behavior of Git's handling of abbreviated SHA-1 hashes in 'index from..to' lines, including setting up specific test cases and verifying outputs.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Generates SHA1 or SHA256 hash of a given value, used for creating object identifiers in tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label and a series of commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files or content.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
